Westinghouse Electric Company provides clean energy solutions through innovative nuclear energy technologies. The Computer Science/Software Engineer will support the selection, development, deployment, and product management of the WNEXUS Software Suite, collaborating with customers, product owners, and engineering teams to manage requirements, standardize processes, and improve data connections across applications.

Responsibilities
Support the WNEXUS Software Deployments daily tasks by leading discussions with internal and external customers on new functionality requests
Stay informed about relevant technology trends and developments to propose best use of toolset and support efficient Data connections across applications
Oversee the product backlog development of the core WNEXUS Suite Applications
Promote standardization into the WNEXUS product management process, through training of individuals and development of standard training material
Support and deliver presentations on the WNEXUS Suite to all partners
Plan, schedule and implement assignments independently within project schedule and budgetary requirements
